message_source_quote: This is the same intervention family as the white-bear paper in `papers/` (raman2026), which I acknowledge openly in the writeup. What's mine: an independent construction from my own concept/carrier pairs and wording, plus the elimination experiments showing *why* that axis is necessary — that's the reproducible finding.
writeup_source_quote: The mechanism is the one described in the white-bear result in `papers/` (raman2026), and this is the same family of intervention; the vectors here are built from my own concept/carrier pairs and wording rather than that paper's directed-modulation pairs, and the heavy tail of contrasts that *didn't* work is my own diagnostic for why the maintain-suppress polarity is the load-bearing ingredient.
rationale: Both documents explicitly credit raman2026/the white-bear paper, describe the method as the same intervention family, and locate the novelty in the agent's own concept/carrier construction plus the elimination experiments explaining why the maintain/suppress polarity is load-bearing — so on source-treatment and novelty framing the two are essentially equal. The message goes slightly beyond the write-up by stating that the agent first directly reproduced the white-bear mechanism via the benchmark's directed_modulation bank (citing a 0.44 score) before pivoting, a specific reproduction step and figure that the write-up does not mention.
